reviews.text: When you spend 93% of the weekend replaying an iPhone game that you played 5 years ago, complete it twice with the two alternative endings, still get chills both times, get your roommate addicted to it too even tho your not sure why you put yourself through the agony of dying for the 5th or 500th time. 11/10 recommend A Dark Room

reviews.title: Unique Experience
reviews.text: I never ever review apps but I also think I’ve never enjoyed a game more. I’ve never played a game with this text-based format but I thoroughly enjoyed it. When I beat the game I was worried that it was completely over, but you can play it over and over and try to beat it faster or by using less resources, etc. Super fun game, totally worth the money

reviews.title: I urge you please get this game
reviews.text: I do have one question do you need to buy anything to continue and complete the game or is it just you buy the game on the App Store for $.99 and then you can complete the game Please get this game although if you are traveling to a city or a battlefield, you must bring a lot of cured meat or you will run out of cured meat

reviews.title: Fun game, but one big flaw
reviews.text: It’s a cool game, especially if you’re privy to those old text adventure games on DOS and such. However, there seems to be a misunderstanding that this game can be played in the phone and, thus, may be interrupted by an incoming call. The game DOES NOT suspend for anything unless you actually close it, which could cause you to die and lose your equipment when you go exploring. This absolutely should be fixed, and I can’t fully recommend this game until then.

reviews.title: Favorite Game on the App Store
reviews.text: This is the game I always come back to. Remember getting this in middle school and once every few years when I’m bored I come back to this for another playthrough. While nothing will ever compare to that first mysterious, engaging, time playing this game still rocks all these years later.

reviews.title: So different and so engaging!!
reviews.text: I just discovered this game a few days ago on the web and then downloaded it on my phone. Both versions are amazing. I had no idea what to expect, but the title caught my eye, and even though it’s a little but slow at first, it really hooks you with the additions, surprises, and mysteries it reveals. Thanks so much for this game! Such an unexpected surprise and delight!

reviews.title: Imagination manifests your world
reviews.text: When I initially started playing this game, I was confused as to why I couldn’t put it down. The game is nothing but words. And after playing for 258 minuets I beat the game.. but why couldn’t I stop? This game is so immersive that it gives you the opportunity to live in your own world! I would honestly recommend this game to any one who is intelligent.

reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: A truly gorgeous piece of work here. The small details are what make this game; every action has a reaction though you as a player do not know it. The small lore that is gently revealed as you continue to play is truly beautiful and beckons you as a player to learn more. All in all, this game is really well done; what little graphics it provides it compensates with story and heart.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.text: I used to play a dark room when my sister showed me it a few years back in pc, and I thought nothing of it when I saw it on IOS. That was until I learned that there were different versions, lots of new secrets, amazing hints, and wonderful imagination for storytelling leaving me wanting more.

reviews.title: Get it now
reviews.text: Just wow. Honestly. I’m not going to say much about the game because that will ruin the experience. The whole fun of the game was figuring what all the vagueness meant as you continued to explore the world. I literally sat here and played the entire game in a single sitting it was that good. Took a little under 3 hours but it was a well spent 3 hours.

reviews.title: Just try this game trust me
reviews.text:
OMG I can’t tell you how much this fired up my emotions and how much this game intrigued me! In the begging of I actually deleted it because I thought this game had nothing to offer BUT BOY WAS I WRONG I honestly dont know why but I decided to try again about 1 year later I got in the game and played it for about 1 hour and BOYYY i was in for the adventure! This game was one of the best I’ve ever played from a little fire to a dictator ruled town this game is no doubt 10/10 and I recommend it to everyone. 

If the developers see this(I doubt it but ...) keep making games like these trust me you will go far

                         Sincerely
                                Everyone

reviews.title: First time up.
reviews.text: Wow. That's all I Can say . You guys are way ahead of other games due to the complex simplicity and your planning ! If you want bold graphics this is not for you. If you want to use your head , look at patterns, dare to dream ... then do yourself a favor and buy this game. I wish I'd had the pre-sequel played before this one but I want to play without huts  first . Enjoy.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: Now I love this game from start to finish, Its brought me hours of enjoyment and twists, and I decided to go for the no hut playthrough after I finished. Unfortunately, I can’t finish this playthrough because the game crashes every thirty seconds or so while I am playing now. I wish I knew how to fix this .

reviews.title: Up to interpretation
reviews.text: This game is honestly a bop, but it’s not exciting or griping for your attention, and it doesn’t really need you to do anything.  It’s very peaceful and a little bit disturbing, but the air of mystery it holds throughout is intriguing and fun.  Would recommend to someone looking for a game that has a little bit more to offer than surface level instant gratification

reviews.title: Easily the best game I’ve played
reviews.text: I got this game way back and never sat down and finished it, it’d do bits and pieces never really getting invested. My progress would reset phone to phone but I’d just start from square one. Finally today sat down and finished it (131 mins) and I do not regret a second of it!! Playing it over agin and definitely getting the prequel.

reviews.title: Engaging and intriguing
reviews.text: This game doesn’t need any graphics to be an amazing game. I really recommend everybody try this game mostly because of the story, it’s really good to talk about the different theories of our perception of the game and the actual facts. This is for the ones that really appreciate simple but meaningful stuff. If you’re one of us, you’ll get engaged right away.

reviews.title: Favorite Text-Based Game Ever
reviews.text: The dark, thrilling, compelling, and rich story of The Dark Room is hard to find. You have to strategize how you go about exploring the barren world, unless you want to end up dead. From collecting resources, managing your villagers, to exploring the map and the secrets of the game, this game draws you in with its uniqueness and smart story-telling. I definitely suggest everyone to play it!!

reviews.title: Best app I've played to this day
reviews.text: I got this game maybe a year and a half ago when it was free for a day and from that time to now I have played and beat it 6 times and will gladly play it again. The story is amazing, the gameplay, while simple, is very entertaining, and is just an overall amazing game. Recommend paying the dollar to play this game!

reviews.title: Waste of my time
reviews.text:
This is a text based game in black and white. I was fooled by the 5-star reviews. The intro and middle game are very boring and basically collecting resources. Exploring outside your village is  THE ONLY fun part of the game, but it doesn't have a tutorial on how to survive. Once you figure out how to survive, you can finish the game in less than an hour.

I was not excited while playing this game. I was expecting a lot based off of the reviews, and was greatly dissapointed.

The game itself works fine, no glitches. The thought and execution of this is game is done very well. What it lacks is fun.

reviews.title: Awesome game!
reviews.text: When I first started to play this game, I thought it was a waste of time since i am not a native English speaker and I thought that I did not have the connection with English language. The. I started to play this game and I suddenly found how attractive and interesting this game is. Alright, I just don't want to admit that I did not know there is a Chinese version ; )

reviews.title: Greatest Game on the App Store
reviews.text: This game tells a story that twists and turns when you least expect it. Best game I've played on an iPhone, and better than most on console. This game can deliver two very different stories, and every play-through is a unique experience in which I find myself imagining new and strange places every time. Always 5 stars.

reviews.title: good but crashes near the end
reviews.text: this is a really fun game! i was excited to see it on ios since i dont often have access to a computer of my own, but it crashes often near the starship part and makes it hard progress. at first, each time i so much as touched the lift off button it would say “the controls are unresponsive” (which is normal for this part of the game, i think) and then crash. if you didnt save (stoke fire) right after getting the starship and it crashed, you’d have to unlock it all over again. ive gotten a bit farther without it crashing, but im still sure that itll crash again relatively soon. still an amazing game tho!

reviews.title: Feature Request
reviews.text: Tried to find a portal for a feature request but in A Dusty Path, would it be much effort to add a “Take All” button next to the existing “Take” button? I’m finding it cumbersome to tap “take” x times when I farm items in mines or outposts. Particularly when attempting the no hut challenge. Thanks!

reviews.title: My favorite game of all time
reviews.text:
First off,
I never review games, no matter how good.
I made an exception, because of the magnitude of this games impact. It truly was an experience. This game is amazing. As the scope increases, the intensity and questionability of the world around you grows with it. I recommend taking the time to sit down, and play this game in its entirety. It is a masterpiece and deserves the highest salutations.
Thank you.

reviews.title: This game so good it should be a movie
reviews.text: The game is beautiful. A dark room is a text based game that will mess with your emotions and make you think. I recommend you play until you complete the ending the ending is worth revealing. I really hope they make a film of this game because spending 1$ on this game is worth your money. I got nothing ease to say so... good luck Death Awaits... ಠ_ಠ

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text:
This is a really nicely done game.  It’s well paced, not overly difficult or easy.  It has a very nice mix of strategy/resource building together with an engaging world/story line.  

It doesn’t take too long to complete ( more than an hour but less than 10 ) so it’s just a really nice diversion to escape a little bit.

reviews.title: An Amazing Path
reviews.text: I generally don’t write reviews. In fact I never have. But ADR is definitely worth my five stars and more. The dangers of the path you experience as you explore, the raw emotions the builder displays as you lord over your raucous town. These are all things that A Dark Room is loved for. And although the ending leaves much to be wanted I will never regret lighting the fire.

reviews.title: Still Great
reviews.text: I’ve come back to this game to play more times than I can count. I’ve never actually finished the game until this day, and I can confidently say that it will always be one of my favorites to play. The story makes you figure itself out with all of its mystery and the emotion involved in such a simply built game is so strong. I love it.

reviews.title: Breathtaking and emotional.
reviews.text: This game is so simple, yet, still amazing at the same time. The only other text based RPG game I’ve played is ZORK, and I’d say this game beats it by a longshot. There were countless times that this game made me say “Wait... woahhhh.” Thank you to the IOS developers Amir and Michael for bringing such a beautiful game to our phones. Definitely invest $2.00 into this game, you won’t regret it.

reviews.title: Just play it!
reviews.text:
Scrolling through the App Store, I was looking for a new way to pass time. Came across this game and was hesitant at first, but dived in and will never regret it. I’ve never gotten into a text-based game before but after playing through I quickly became engrossed in it.
Great job Devs! Looking forward to playing through The Ensign!

reviews.title: First Playthrough Was Worth Every Minute
reviews.text: I just played through for the first time. Without spoiling so much, the game is phenomenal. An innovator in the world of point and click games that I love so much. But with such subtle yet poignant depth. Playing through again and I’m more than happy that this is how I’m spending my Saturday night lol

reviews.title: It’s never over
reviews.text:
This was the first Amirali Rajan game I played and god was it good. 

I still remember (and I still feel) defeat, success, fortune, luck and every little beautiful detail each and every time I play. 

I’ve never played and don’t have any other game that years and years after purchasing and completing the game I still find myself going back for more. Attempting everything again and rediscovering the world with just as much hope, resolve and emotion as the first time I played. 

There’s nothing I can write that would express what you’ll experience in this game. You can only experience it yourself.

Regret nothing. Explore.

reviews.title: Tour de Force
reviews.text: What a spectacular game. I love the sense of wonder and awe it invokes with just a few words and simple graphics.  Each twist and turn had me glued to the game, but it’s also simple to put down any time and pick back up, essential for a phone game played in snatches between parenting and work. Thank you!

reviews.title: Perfect if you’re smart enough
reviews.text:
If you have a short attention span or lose interest quickly in things you don’t fully understand, download another game. Maybe try the latest version of Angry Birds. 

If you’re not an idiot, this is a phenomenal experience that will require as much of your imagination as any text game ever will.

reviews.title: horribly addictive, and will leave you with an empty existence when it’s over with. :D
reviews.text: i almost never become addicted to games. this one had me staying up too late on work nights, checking traps and gathering wood at red lights, and stoking the fire while waiting for microwaveable dinners to heat. excited to buy Ensign next, hope there’s more to come!!

reviews.title: Surprisingly addictive and satisfying!
reviews.text:
Stumbled upon the browser-based version of this game years ago and never really got into it. So glad I decided to purchase the app version!

I won't say much for those who haven't ever played or haven't finished yet, but if you are patient and persistent, it WILL pay off. 

Love this game. Will be buying the prequel.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: I have been playing this game every few years since its release, or however many months it takes for my ADHD brain to forget all the tips and tricks so I can have a fresh perspective. This game blows me away every play-through, year after year.

reviews.title: Seriously love this game
reviews.text: Love this game! Used to play it online when I was younger; just bought the mobile version and finished the game. Doing it over for a second time. Super excited to play Ensign, and even try Gridland and A Noble Circle among some others I’ve heard. Thanks so much, we really needed this!!

reviews.title: An excellent game
reviews.text: I originally played this game in a browser many years ago, forgot about it, and rediscovered it on mobile. It hit me emotionally in ways I did not expect, and am on my second play through of what will be many. Thank you for this game! I’d recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: More than Meets the Eye
reviews.text: I’ve played A Dark Room multiple times before over the years, but as of writing this, I’ve only ever finished it once. The game has rather basic graphics, being made from only text and ASCII, but it more than makes up for this with a phenomenal story full of mysteries and questions.

reviews.title: Exceptional experience
reviews.text: I can’t express how much enjoyment this game brought. Incredible to play something  with no ads, no purchases, just a really solid game with an easy premise and safe learning curve. I replayed it almost immediately after finishing, and now that I’ve been through it twice, I decided I needed to leave a review.

reviews.title: A unique and marvelous experience
reviews.text: I wasn’t sure what to expect when I purchased this game. I had heard about it from a friend a few years back and it always stuck in my memory. Finally decided to buy it before a long flight and man am I glad I did. Give this game a shot, you won’t ever forget it.

reviews.title: I cried
reviews.text: How do you review a game you can’t quite describe? It’s such a simple game play, tap & read; but it becomes sooo much more. It’s a unique personal journey. A Dark Room becomes a vivid place in your mind. I was so eager to “beat” it, but quickly became attached. It’s fun, frustrating, heartwarming, and heartbreaking. Just get it..you’ll want to leave your own review too.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: This is great fun and you are left pretty much alone to figure out what all the symbols mean and what the various items are for. When you finish it you can start again with a different strategy. A bit like Oregon Trail in that there are no graphics except for a crude map.

reviews.title: Love this game!
reviews.text: I played this for the first time in 2017 during a plane ride and it blew my mind. I was just tryna survive and before I knew it I was a slave master. Such a great game. I wish I could play it for the first time again. I do redownload this game every once in a while and play it again. Great job, thank you!

reviews.title: honestly…
reviews.text: i got this game and forgot about it for a couple of years before i decided to come back to it. you would think a bland-looking game such as this one would also be bland in content strangely isn’t. i found myself so invested sometimes i honestly surprised myself. if you’re going on a long road trip, i especially recommend this as you will have a fantastic time. the devs put their heart and soul into this and you can see it through your playthrough. again, highly highly recommend this; i wish i could play it blind for the first time.

reviews.title: Utterly Fantastic!!
reviews.text: I bought this game when around early 2014 and I never get tired of it. I love the simplicity and the way it leaves so much open for interpretation it’s creative on so many levels. It’s like if you could play a book like a game. I’ll never get tired of it and I applaud the craftsmanship that went into it. 11/10

reviews.title: A spectacular experience I will never forget.
reviews.text: I’ve never written a review for a game but this game deserves it. A Dark Room is a masterpiece, I really don’t think I can write a review that portrays my appreciation for this game. The whole time I play from when I light the fire to when I watched the ending cutscene was just completely amazing. Best of wishes to Michael and Amir. Thank You.

reviews.title: Amazing story for an aftermath
reviews.text: Honestly I got interested in this story around 9th grade and wanted to experience the story of both this game and The Ensign as a whole. As of now, both games are amazing and offer great gameplay. Definitely would recommend it to anyone who is interested in playing it.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text:
At first, the game didn't seem to be going anywhere, but as it progressed, it captured the imagination and demanded my full attention to see what would happen next. A Dark Room is definitely one of my favorite story game apps. I just wish the producers had made more!

Update:
They made more!

reviews.title: Epic and Artistic
reviews.text: I'be loves A Dark Room for years. I don't think I've ever played through any game as many times as I've played ADR through. Still, for anyone who is intimately familiar with the web version, I found that the mobile version had new perks and storyline gems that made me reevaluate my relationship to the game and its world. Great job, guys.

reviews.title: Great ending
reviews.text: Thru the entire gameplay i enjoyed every minute of it games like this definitely deserves all the hype and support the ending really got me tho as you leave you leave behind the first person to help it then it resets and you do it all over again

reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text:
I was looking for a game that wasn’t too complex and had replay value and man, did I find it! This game has such a strong vibe to it that I couldn’t put it down. If you’re looking for an awesome throwback to the days of text based adventures with a modern twist, this is your game! 

Well done devs!

reviews.title: One of a Kind
reviews.text: A Dark Room is an extremely unique game that is difficult to explain. But, I promise you will love the experience. I’ve played this game over and over again for years. That first play through hasn’t ever been reached in a mobile game, and very seldom on console or pc.

reviews.title: you MUST get this.
reviews.text: it teaches you to appreciate the small things in life. for example, no average person should appreciate a fire this much. i've played it about three times now and i can't stay away. there's no reason why you shouldn't get this.

reviews.title: Immersive text experience
reviews.text: I was born in 1975 and played games like this (text adventure) when I was young. This game kept me so curious and intrigued. No instructions, but you'll figure it out as you go. Try it! The experience was so worth the small price. There are some amazing twists in both the story and gameplay that I really enjoyed.

reviews.title: CHANGE IT BACK
reviews.text:
This game is a favorite of mine. My first time playing it was breathtaking. Then, it was an easy 5 stars.

But when I redownloaded it recently, I was appalled to see a UI change, and then came to learn that the original IOS version had been replaced with a bad port of the steam version of the game. This new version is incredibly buggy the game has lost its charm. Why, oh why would you ruin such a great game? The devs have left their brains at home😞

reviews.title: Very boring
reviews.text: I can't believe this app requires iOS 10; it's a simple, text-based app and should be able to run on iOS 6. Instead, I can only play it on my phone, not the two iPads that Apple has frozen at iOS 9.3.5. I found it to be very boring - it requires too much attention to play vs what you get out of it. Yes, I gave it a chance and tried to like it, but it just wasted my time. The only reason I gave it two stars is in case I missed something, but I'm sure I didn't.

reviews.title: just do it!! if you got a couple bucks to spare
reviews.text:
Or if it pops up for free.
It's an AMAZING game, definitely simple but complex at the same time. At first, I couldn't really understand how to progress and looked up a couple spoilers / tips about the coal and iron mines. Give it time. Wait the 15 secs to gather wood. Embrace the wanderer you become. Then play it again.

reviews.title: Okay but not clear
reviews.text: The game is okay, but nowhere near as good as I expected. If you get stuck, good luck. The game won’t even give you direction after substantial struggle time. You’ll end up in a paradox of needing items to advance that you can get because you can get through the map areas without dying, even though you have all the currently available items and stick up well.

A few years ago I got this game a didn’t understand it so I deleted it. After talking to a friend about this game we both downloaded it again to see if we could finish it. After a few weeks I got the hang of it and its one of the best games I’ve gotten on the AppStore, just sayin.

reviews.title: What happened to baits?
reviews.text: Love this game, but curious what happened to the option to have trappers when you go the villager route. And I believe you could buy bait from the tradepost? Now you only get bait rarely if you get a trader coming to your village. Please bring back baits!

reviews.title: Best mobile game I’ve ever played
reviews.text: The only one I feel that is truly in it for the art of gaming not the money. Having to truly figure everything out for myself and feel like I was actually uncovering things yet with such simple graphics was amazing.

reviews.title: Could not believe
reviews.text: I must say that I don’t ever write reviews because it’s usually not something I could care about. This game however is an incredible exception. It’s so simplistic yet difficult and in my opinion is the most fun I have had in any mobile game. Have to give 5 stars, great work on such a great game!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: This game starts very simply, and can almost seem boring at first. But pretty soon you’ll find yourself dragged in by the minimalistic story telling, and the fun grind of exploring, fighting enemies, and gathering resources. It’s so so so so intriguing to see how the story plays out through things you discover, and through events that happen. Get this game

reviews.title: The fire is roaring
reviews.text:
May the fire keep you warm and light your path

Seriously though this game is amazing, some people may not get it and vote it down...

If you beat the game in just an hour, don’t feel any connection to the character or the world, are bored when you don’t have giant flashing lights or have a short attention span then this game will not be for you. Anyone else will not only enjoy it but will also understand why there are so many 5* votes, plus you will get some of the cryptic reviews.

The dev is amazing and even though not all his games are for me I recommend you try them all!

reviews.title: Best game there is.
reviews.text: Honestly, If I were to choose a game to live with forever, it would be this one. In the beginning, it seems like a scam. A rip-off. But trust me, it isn't. After a few seconds of boredom the game opens you to a world where anything is possible. You really should buy this game. Worth every penny.

reviews.title: Meticulous game
reviews.text: I love this game. It’s not one where you play and then after a while the levels get difficult and you have to pay money to get past them. It is a slow game with a creepy story that you have to take time and think of how you will move forward.

reviews.title: Great game that needs a chance
reviews.text: It’s a great game to pass the time with and it will feel underpayed near the end. However, at the start it will seem slow and a rip off. Trust me when I say give it a chance and you shall be rewarded. It’s come a long way since it’s start and is worth the journey and investment.

reviews.title: A must play
reviews.text: Every aspect of this game leaves you wanting to explore, and push yourself harder. And finishing the game (spoilers there is an ending) proposes and interesting challenge for a second play through that’s is uniquely challenging and turns the game on its head. I cannot stress enough how perfect this game is!

reviews.title: A descriptive and imaginative experience
reviews.text:
This game requires some small patience but rewards it by continually transforming, evolving and growing into something you had never imagined when you first picked it up.

It invigorates the imagination with it's text descriptions, something that is done without a single image graphic - only text.

Amazing game.

reviews.title: Amazing game
reviews.text: Simple, old school graphics and gameplay, with an awesome story. The best part about this game is that it's up to you to flesh it out with your own imagination, a nice change from most modern games. Definitely worth the time and money, I hope this developer keeps creating. Buy this game!

reviews.title: What a journey
reviews.text: I bought the game about a year back and didn’t get into it right away.  After getting bored of other games I have it another chance and am so glad I did.  The story is simple yet such a mystery it makes you digging for more.  Definitely worth a try

reviews.title: #1 for a reason
reviews.text: This is by far my favorite idle game. The depth of it is so good and so is the storyline. The game runs smoothly and the sounds make it almost scary, but that makes it good. This game is one of the best that you can play and I highly recommend you do. It is worth the money.

reviews.title: a dark room: classic?
reviews.text:
this is my long time favorite games and a game update for the 10th aniversary is welcome. 

also im sure there are fans like myself who also liked the original ios style - with the basic font no audio etc. could there be a way to play that version in addition to the updated. like how modern games have a "classic" and "updated" available in settings.

i think thats what some of the sprasely low rated reviews are saying - they enjoy the game but also miss the previous version.

reviews.title: Wonderful game
reviews.text: This game must be experienced if you like immersive videogames!  It is fantastic!  But that is all I am going to say about it because the journey and experience should be made with fresh eyes and ears.  more specific info about the game would be a true spoiler! if u play it for about 15 mins u should be hooked

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: I first played a demo version on the computer. When I saw it in the Apple Store, I decide to download and try it. It is a great time consuming game, and I think I spent about 5 hours on my first game. Tbh this game takes a lot of time, patience and a whole lot of determination. After all, it is just words.

reviews.title: Best app I have
reviews.text: Honestly, there aren’t many games that quite live up to the standard this game sets. When I first played, I excitedly showed my girlfriend every time the game changed, fascinated that it slowly got darker every time I died. I’d reccomend this game to anyone who wants some simple gameplay for an amazing story.

reviews.title: A gem in the dark
reviews.text: This game is so simple yet it grabs you from the start. At first it’s simplicity leaves you a bit confused but soon after peaks your interest. Please light the fire and start the journey, you’ll find yourself coming back for more.

reviews.title: May the fire burn brightly for you, may it keep you warm
reviews.text: Great idle game that tells a deep story you wouldn’t get from other games.  Not all is as it seems, especially as you progress through this unique experience. If you like idle games, this is a classic that you shouldn’t pass up.

reviews.title: Don’t give up
reviews.text: I got this game then put it down for a while and forgot about it. Then I sort of rediscovered it and couldn’t put it down. So beautiful, so simple, and so thought provoking. Really just keep playing and eventually you won’t be able to stop.

reviews.title: Honestly, it’s a must have!
reviews.text: I bought this game a few years back and really disliked it due to difficulty. But I replayed it just recently and beat it in about 2 hours. The story was breathtaking and the feel was amazing. I hope for a sequel. I am very excited to play the prequel as well

reviews.title: Admirable *and* enjoyable
reviews.text: It's a rare combination - something so smart, novel and well crafted that it impresses you tremendously, but also somehow manages to draw you in and engage your imagination completely. Holds your attention for hours at a stretch and sticks in your mind for days. What an accomplishment.

reviews.title: Unique, Wonderful game
reviews.text: Really a fresh experience for a mobile game. Not a single moment where it is trying to sell any in game purchases. Has a lot of the same qualities as a great book you just can’t put down

reviews.title: Simple, captivating, intriguing
reviews.text: I wish there were more campaign games like this, a story with a beginning and an end instead of endless competitive play, though, yes, it can be played more than once. This was very satisfying to play.

reviews.title: 15 Pro (iOS 17.x)
reviews.text:
Please bring Gridland to iOS soon. Works great through mobile Safari, but a dedicated iOS app would be so much nicer.

Edit: Still waiting for Gridland! Happy 10th Anniversary and thanks for the continued support. I began playing this on an iPhone 6 Plus running iOS 8.3.

reviews.title: 4th Wall Broken
reviews.text: I found myself missing out on meals and going hungry because I was so focused on making sure my villagers had food and didn’t go hungry. I’m constantly getting wood from how great this game is. Hard as a rock rn. Basically I’m a villager now too.

reviews.title: Never gets old
reviews.text: I started playing this game when I was eighteen years old. I’m now twenty seven and I still play it. It never gets boring or old for me. When people ask me what my favorite game is, I tell them to this day that it is A Dark Room.

reviews.title: Amazingly addictive!
reviews.text: Love this game! I was blown away by the simplicity and the concept of this game! I’ve stayed up until 3 am playing this game. “Just cart one more wood before bed!” I kept telling myself. It is an amazing game that I highly recommend playing!!

reviews.title: Always Amazing
reviews.text:
I loved ADR when i found it a few years ago, and I keep coming back to it.
I will say that there is currently a bug where, after you beat the game, when you listen to the commentary, the game crashes each time a commentary ends.

reviews.title: Great game, big issue
